description: Paper-exact per-block log-form B(Z,N) = Σ_λ w_λ m_e Σ_i ln|Φ_q(V̂_i^λ)| from prop:tower-binding-energy.  Uses the log-form of Φ_q which is well-defined past |V̂| = q via ln|1 − q^{-k}v| = ln|q^{-k}v − 1| for q^{-k}v > 1 (the 'analytic continuation past the pole' in the paper).  QED correction (1 − α_EM/2) applied per prop:deuterium-derived-binding.
